score.rationale: This proposal is an exemplary model for a technical spike, demonstrating exceptional clarity and focus. The 'Why' section perfectly articulates the primary business and technical risk being addressed, framing the problem with precision. The scope is tightly constrained to the minimal work required to de-risk the core unknown—validating a specific workflow shape—and explicitly excludes anything beyond that goal. Technical feasibility is high due to its nature as a targeted investigation with clear risk identification and fallback planning. Lifecycle linkage is also strong, explicitly connecting this spike to downstream feature work and other project artifacts. The acceptance criteria are clear and actionable, though they could be slightly more precise by detailing the expected inputs/outputs for each step in the test case.
